en: Jātaka: The Second Book of Birth Stories (Dukanipāta), Chapter on the Yellow Robe (Kāsāvavagga)
“With elephant-herds like clouds, with rows of excellent horses, with chariots raising dust, and raining down arrows;”
Takṣaśilā is surrounded on all sides by those who wield firm blows with the grip of their swords;
Various sounds were uttered by the speaking birds;
a tumultuous noise arose from them,
like the flash of lightning from a thundering cloud.
